reasoning.text: Reproducibility is solid on the functional layer — all numeric parameters (q, N, psi, omega, Ninv, Barrett constants, widths, 8 BUs) are pinned and both impls agree, with round-trip and negacyclic identities verified — but the spec leaves the paper's actual conflict-free (bank,offset) mapping, crossbar permutation, and twiddle-reuse loop source-missing, forcing both impls to invent the SAME XOR-fold stand-in. That same gap is the biggest fidelity hole: the CFNTT paper's defining contribution (the specific conflict-free memory scheme and bit-reversal-free natural-order datapath) is not actually reproduced — the impls deliver a correct generic negacyclic NTT with the right parameters but not the specific architecture the reference describes.
gaps: [operation] Paper's actual conflict-free (bank,offset) mapping function and per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s (the headline Sec. III contribution)
[operation] Twiddle-ROM addressing function f(stage,block) under the rearranged twiddle-reuse loop
[control] Exact FSM transition table and per-state cycle latencies (only aggregate 9 cycles/lane given)
[param] Naive-radix-4 add/sub baseline (10 assumed) that pins the 20% reduction claim
[operation] Whether output is genuinely bit-reversal-free in hardware vs. computed bit-reversed then relabeled
[param] Specific 14-bit modulus of the paper benchmark (q=12289 is a reproduction fix, not the stated prime)
[port] Host PCIe/DMA framing, beat packing and handshake (explicitly reproduction-invented)
